title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 16
description:
Elevate any bedroom with this personalized Baseball Comforter Set, thoughtfully designed for sports enthusiasts. Showcasing your love for the game, this set from Jeminise offers both comfort and a unique, custom touch, making it an ideal gift for baseball players and fans alike.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: Perfect for baseball players, fans, and lovers, celebrating determination and passion for the sport.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88") to fit various bed sizes.
  • Superior Manufacturing Process: Environmentally friendly finishing ensures dye retention and prevents fading, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching for lasting durability.
  • Soft & Comfy Material: Made from 100% Brushed Polyester Fabric, offering a soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight feel.
  • Microfiber Filling: Features whole-piece microfiber filling with tight stitching to prevent clumping or shifting, ensuring consistent comfort.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable; wash separately in cold water and air dry without heat for best results, maintaining fluffiness.
  • Custom Options: Includes options for personalization with up to two text inputs for a unique touch.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Duvet Cover Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Selected Design Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 2 text inputs
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Special Feature Breathable
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Thread Count 400
